name: Nostril Darkness
algorithm: Nostril Darkness — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes nostril darkness and rendering for deepfake detection:

1. **Nostril検出**: The nostrils are detected per frame as dark interior regions visible at the base of the nose. Their shape (typically oval), size, and darkness level are measured.

2. **DarknessLevel分析**: Natural nostrils show very low luminance (dark cavity) with specific spectral properties (warm dark due to skin back-scattering). The method measures nostril darkness and compares against expected values. AI generators may produce nostrils that are: too bright (failing to render the cavity), too uniform (lacking internal light gradients), or with incorrect color temperature.

3. **Bilateral対称性**: Left and right nostrils should be approximately symmetric in size and darkness (adjusted for head pose). The method checks bilateral nostril consistency. AI generators may produce asymmetric nostrils or nostrils that change relative size between frames.

4. **Pose-DependentVisibility**: Nostril visibility changes predictably with head pitch — looking up shows more nostril interior, looking down hides them. The method verifies that nostril appearance changes correctly with estimated head pose. Incorrect pose-dependent nostril rendering indicates AI generation.

5. **時間的Nostril安定性**: Nostril dark regions should maintain consistent shape and position across frames (nostrils don't move relative to nose). The method tracks nostril features over time. Frame-to-frame nostril instability — changing shape, flickering darkness, shifting position — indicates per-frame independent rendering.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through nostril darkness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
